sections.title: Introducing Yourself
sections.content: Use the verb 'ser' to say who you are and where you are from: 'soy' for I am, 'eres' for you are, 'es' for he, she or it is. To give your name you can either use 'soy' with the name directly, or 'me llamo', which literally means 'I call myself' and is the more usual choice when meeting someone.
Spanish usually omits the subject pronoun, because the verb ending already says who is doing the action. Say 'Soy Carlos.', not 'Yo soy Carlos.'
